headline: A new foundation for the pack
summary: Update 1.5 moves the pack to Forge, rebuilds MineColonies on its latest version and adds 26 new mods packed with dungeons, dimensions, bosses and gear.

features.title: Dungeons, dimensions and bosses
features.text: Alex's Caves, Eternal Starlight, Seven Seas, Bosses of Mass Destruction, Dragon Mounts and plenty more.

features.title: Fully up to date
features.text: About 700 builds newer, with smarter citizens and the crash that took the server down on October 4 gone.

features.title: Cheese is back
features.text: Growthcraft cheese curds can be made in the Mixing Vat again, and the Resources tab now has 11 resource packs.

features.title: 48 hours, a success
features.text: 13 issues caught and fixed, and no revert to 1.4 is expected. Next up: 1.6 Starlight Create, moving the pack to Create 6.
